column1: # The cases of tests/fixtures/worth/adversarial.tsv that worth-check.py
# classifies otherwise than the verdict an independent tester owes them, kept
# as documented limits of the heuristic (SPEC-0009, HEURISTIC_SPARES_A_READ_BACK).
# tests/test-worth-check.sh (X806) holds each row at the verdict it records here,
# so a fix shows in the gate and its row moves out of this file. Every other
# row of adversarial.tsv is gated at the verdict the tester owes it.
# Columns: test, owed, got, class (false-positive | false-negative | not-read),

column5: the assertion sits in a helper the check does not follow; a call it cannot see into is read as logic
a constant held equal to a file reads as two homes with no literal between them, which WORTH_SPARES_LOGIC_TESTS spares
a fixture parameter is opaque to a static reading, so a snapshot fixture reads as logic
toMatchSnapshot() holds no literal in the test; the literal lives in a snapshot file the runner writes
a name that names a regression is the author's declaration, and WORTH_SPARES_BUG_REGRESSIONS spares it

round 2: a security setting keyed by a string (Content-Security-Policy) is flagged, since the security spare reads identifiers and never string content; the same setting as a constant (SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE) is spared
